content.short: South Park Commons is a community of technologists and developers dedicated to helping each other, exploring and learning.
content.description: South Park Commons is a venture capital firm and a community that gathers talented people to share ideas, explore directions, and realize opportunities. The organization provides an environment where developers can take risks and launch their next venture. It was founded by founders and founding engineers from Facebook, Dropbox, Stripe, Planet, Meraki, Pilot, and other companies. By connecting people and ideas, it helps members discover new ways to make a difference in the world.
